missing.reason: Must be live; the local simulation is not an external proof environment.
A dedicated canonical workspace UUID is required.
A dedicated guardrail PostgreSQL login is required.
Owner issuer must be a trusted HTTPS origin.
An explicit owner allowlist is required.
A positive authorization version is required.
A scoped signing-key ring is required.
A trusted HTTPS owner origin is required.
The exact owner HTTPS callback must match the cockpit origin.
A public HTTPS guardrail webhook origin is required.
A development app ID is required.
A development app secret of at least 16 characters is required in the guardrail environment.
Exactly one explicitly allowlisted myshopify.com development store is required.
Required pilot read and product-write scopes are missing.
A 32-byte base64 connector key is required.
The emergency reader must use a trusted HTTPS root origin separate from the owner and webhook origins.
A non-demo emergency read credential is required.
A named staging backup/restore target is required; this check does not prove a restore.
Choose DURABLE_BACKGROUND, OWNER_MANUAL for a deliberately operated drill, or DISABLED.
